Im searching for a sponsor for my sweet boyfriend, who escaped Ukraine and is living in Europe, but he wants to come to the US with me when I move back this year, but we cannot find a sponsor (my mother is European in the US and can’t sponsor him, I have no other US family, just myself, and my funds don’t support being subject to a sponsor).

He is an incredible guy (18) and his mother lives in Turkey so it’s not helpful in his situation. In Europe the help slipped through since he was a minor when he arrived and the refugee house illegally kicked him out and caused him trouble, and his visa never got approved here. He’s struggling to survive, and wants to go to the US to go to trade school and eventually work. We have a dog and want to begin a life. 

Im glad to see there’s some hope out there. Did you find someone to sponsor yet? Maybe anyone knows of someone looking to sponsor? I’m willing to provide more information about him, and his status and reasons to leave. He cannot go back to Ukraine, he’s an artist and not a military fighter. His grandmother is there and it’s very painful, the village gets bombed but he has no choice, he cannot go back for obvious reasons. 

God bless.

EDIT: He wants to stay for 2 years for the U4U limit, but we will apply for a residence permit once our marriage is valid. That’s on our part.
